source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Unaccusativity diagnostics in Sakha: Causative alternation and others
notes: Only agentive predicates can appear in the comitative voice which requires an agentive predicate. This rules out comitative unaccusatives while allowing comitative unergatives.
en: Erel helped (lit. worked together with others) at the farm during the summer.
